facts.business: TCI Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company (NBFC) engaged in lending and investment activities, currently facing regulatory non-compliance regarding minimum Net Owned Funds and contingent liabilities from invoked corporate guarantees.

auditor.name: M/s G.D. Upadhyay & Co., Chartered Accountant, Hyderabad (FRN: 005834S)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (1) Non-recognition of Rs. 17,820.89 Lakhs liability from invoked corporate guarantees of Amrit Jal Ventures and Gati Infrastructure Bhasmey Power, which should have been recognized per auditor; (2) Going concern basis inappropriate due to liabilities from invoked guarantees and insufficient evidence. Emphasis of matter on RBI communication regarding non-compliance with minimum Net Owned Funds and advice to surrender Certificate of Registration.

key_risks: Non-recognition of Rs. 17,820.89 Lakhs contingent liability from invoked corporate guarantees
Going concern uncertainty due to liabilities from invoked guarantees and regulatory non-compliance
RBI non-compliance with minimum Net Owned Funds requirement, advised to surrender Certificate of Registration
Negative other equity and accumulated losses
